description_en: Queries the execution status of a legacy task that modifies synchronization objects
description_zh: 老版查询修改同步对象任务的执行状态
name: DescribeSynchronizationObjectModifyStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This value is returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49451.html operation to modify synchronization objects
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49451.html接口修改同步对象时会返回该值
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value on your client and make sure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated soon
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DataInitializationStatus.description_en: The status of the initial full data synchronization

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the initial full data synchronization fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 全量数据初始化失败的错误提示
ErrorMessage.example: DTS-070211: Connect Source DB failed. cause by [com.mysql.jdbc.exceptions.jdbc4.MySQLNonTransientConnectionException:Could not create connection to database server. Attempted reconnect 3 times. Giving up.][com.mysql.jdbc.exceptions.jdbc4.CommunicationsException:Communications link failure\n\nThe last packet sent successfully to the server was 0 milliseconds ago. Percent.description_en: The progress of the initial full data synchronization. Unit: %

Progress.description_zh: 已完成全量数据初始化的记录数

Status.description_en:
The status of the synchronization object modification. Valid values:
notstarted: not started
migrating: synchronizing
failed: synchronization failed
finaciallocked: financial lock
Status.description_zh: 同步对象变更状态，取值包括：-notstarted：未启动。-migrating：同步中。-failed：同步失败。-finaciallocked：欠费锁定
